notes.title: Arkio v2.0.0
notes.notes:
With Arkio 2.0, we are taking design collaboration to a whole new level, whether you’re doing design ideation, design reviews, or immersive client presentations. Many areas of Arkio have been re-imagined.

Features:
- Generative AI camera
- Collaborative image frames
- Voice transcription notes
- Layer visibility
- New UI & file manager
- ArchiCAD imports
- Presentation mode
- Improved walls & components
- Cloud scene sharing
- Multi-language text fields
- Other improvements and bug fixes

Section and program/material rendering mode now synchronized among all meeting participants. Simplified geometry when exporting from Rhino using the Arkio Rhino Plugin. Export from Arkio to Rhino now available on all platforms. Minor updates and bug fixes.

This version includes significant performance updates in meetings as well as increased stability when doing multi-user modeling operations. Arkio scenes and imported assets are now encrypted end-to-end when in meetings. Several improvements have been done to meeting audio, including echo cancellation.

notes.title: Updated default SteamVR Oculus Touch controller bindings
notes.notes: Some Oculus users where missing controller bindings for Arkio. This update should fix the default bindings that come with Arkio.
